messages:
elaine: Quick launch freeze — need owners for SLA, docs, support runbook, monitoring dashboards, and pricing pages. Reply with 'ok' + area you'll own by EOD.

devon: ok SLA (will write SLOs). quick q: stick with 99.9% hosted / 99.5% dedicated as discussed?

mike: ok docs + pricing page updates. will add quickstart, migration guide, and pricing examples. ETA tomorrow 12:00 PT.

sara: ok monitoring + alerts. need critical signals list: tail latency (p95/p99), queue length, error rate, token cost per minute.

ops-bot: Reminder: runbook template v2 available at https://redwood.internal/runbooks/v2 — use `/inc runbook create` to scaffold.

elaine: Assigning cross-checks: @mike add "upgrade path" section in docs; @devon add accepted degradation modes and burst behavior in SLA; @sara embed runbook links into dashboards. I'll own support rota + training.

mike: heads-up — embeddings customers asked for explicit burst SLA detail. @devon can you call out fallback behavior for bursts?

devon: yep — will add fallback tier + capacity exceptions. draft wording: `If sustained QPS > reserved_capacity, latency SLO may degrade; requests will automatically fallback to compatible model variant.` thoughts?

sara: sounds good. alert thresholds proposal: p99 > 1.5s sustained for 5m, or error_rate > 0.5% across service. Also alert on queue_length > 200.

elaine: :thumbsup: I'll collate into a launch checklist doc. Action owners recap: SLA — devon; Docs & pricing — mike; Monitoring & alerts — sara; Support runbook + training — elaine. Please ack here.

mike: Ack. I'll post links to PRs when ready.

devon: Ack, ETA EOD for SLA draft.

sara: Ack, pairing with oncall tomorrow 09:30 PT to validate dashboards.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: docs site build succeeded for main — build 1775001400.

elaine: If blockers pop up, ping #release-war-room. We'll run a dry run Fri AM and validate ops playbook. Thanks everyone.
